title_zh: 请访客不要把烟放在长椅上

scenario.goal_zh: 指出烟头可能损坏物品并请访客使用指定容器。

context_zh: 公园工作人员看到一名访客把点燃的香烟放在木椅边缘，礼貌提出请求。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Park Attendant Eva
sentences.text: Excuse me. Please do not leave your cigarette on the bench.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Joel
sentences.text: Sorry. I only put it down to answer my phone.

sentences.speaker: Park Attendant Eva
sentences.text: It could burn the wood. There is a proper ash container by the gate.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Joel
sentences.text: I see it. I will use that instead.

sentences.speaker: Park Attendant Eva
sentences.text: Thank you. That helps us keep the benches in good condition.
